findings.finding: Satisfaction with the music used in an exercise setting accounts for the largest share of variance in exercise enjoyment.
findings.quote: satisfaction with music (21%) accounted for the most variance in exercise enjoyment

findings.finding: Participants experience greater enjoyment and achievement when dancing with partners who share good rapport and compatible approaches.
findings.quote: gained greater enjoyment and sense of achievement from dance classes in comparison to couples who did not enjoy dancing together

findings.finding: Enjoyment is a significant predictor of out-of-class physical activity levels among participants.
findings.quote: Significant effects of gender, group, enjoyment, and intensity on out-of-class weekly aerobic activity were observed

principle: Exercise enjoyment, which heavily drives continued participation, is strongly boosted by music satisfaction, positive instructor interactions, and supportive social or partner dynamics.
for_the_teacher: Play music that learners genuinely enjoy to maximize their overall satisfaction and motivation.
Foster positive social interactions and community elements within the online platform to support engagement and well-being.
